messages.subject: Upgrade R version on 'spark' server?
parts:
Hi,

Our current version of R on our 'spark' server is:
version.string R version 2.15.3 (2013-03-01)

Is there a way to upgrade this to the latest R version 3.0.1?

All the best,

John

messages.author: 47e7aa9b192efc0d
messages.subject: Re: Upgrade R version on 'spark' server?
parts:
Is the R version on the server shared among everyone on the server?  'spark', 'glimmer', etc.?

yes/no?

messages.author: 55771919c42cb6a1
messages.subject: Re: Upgrade R version on 'spark' server?
parts:
Hi John -

Unfortunately, at this point, upgrading R requires a system-wide change, which would break everyone's installed packages, since packages built for R 2.15 won't work with 3.0.

We working on a solution to this, which hopefully we'll be able to make available in a month or so.

Best,
-Winston

messages.author: edbcc711cdbb3da8
messages.subject: Re: Upgrade R version on 'spark' server?
parts:
Hi Nick,
We are not making any investments in upgrading Spark or Glimmer, and will be looking at migrating them over to ShinyApps.io as it gets into beta.  
If you haven't done so already, I would encourage you to create an account on shinyapps.io and use that infrastructure instead.  It will provide you with a greater degree of control over the packages and versions of R you are using, while ensuring better scalability and isolation.

Best,
Tareef
